title: The Muddy Paw Mischief
intro: Someone has let every adoptable puppy out of its pen during the pet adoption fair, and the rescue volunteers are scrambling to find the culprit.

suspects.name: Nadia
suspects.line: I was signing forms the whole morning, ask anyone.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I was busy with the bunnies, honest!

suspects.name: Tobias
suspects.line: Dogs love me. I have never once let one loose.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: Why would I open gates? I'm allergic to fur.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I only came for the kittens, I swear on my scarf.

clues.text: Witnesses swore they heard jingling keys near the gate just before the pens popped open, so whoever came by was carrying a bunch of keys.
Nobody at the desk was tapping a clipboard during the escape, so the culprit is not tapping clipboard; the clipboard taps were all heard far from the pens.
Muddy paw prints lead everywhere, yet the culprit's hands were clean: the culprit is not muddy gloves, as the gloves were found dry and spotless.
A volunteer who was whistling the whole morning has a sure alibi: the culprit is not whistling, since whistling could be heard across the fair the entire time.
